message: 魔王で行こう！

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Deep-fried bread crusts coated in sugar might look dirt-poor, but I'll admit they're damn tasty.」

name: Synn
message: 「That doesn't matter right now.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then what is it? About the patrols getting canceled?」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's just a whim of Professor Sengen'in's, that's fine.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if she's a Demon General, she's still a Demon. Acting on a whim is totally on the table.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, Pasta, Professor Sengen'in, and Bylous--all of them acting on a whim?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, no way in hell. It's only natural to figure they share a common goal.」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's the case, it's not over yet.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even Helena's thought that far. Probably the rest of the Student Council too.」

name: Synn
message: 「And yet, the reason Helena-san won't let us investigate... isn't it because we wouldn't be able to beat them?」
Those two presences.
As we are now, there's no way we could possibly beat either of them.

name: Paqy
message: 「As the one entrusted with the academy, she can't exactly stand by and watch students get turned into mincemeat.」

name: Synn
message: 「If we were stronger... strong enough to beat them, wouldn't Helena-san have let us keep patrolling?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Maybe. Still, what you can't do, you can't do.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know, but. Still, I'm the Demon Lord, and with the Demon Lord's power.」

name: Paqy
message: 「With your current power, Demon Lord, even fighting Pasta one-on-one would be dicey. Taking on Fatso is about the best you could manage.」

name: Synn
message: 「I learned that much yesterday. Besides, Eauderourke isn't fat--I think that's just how his species looks.」

name: Paqy
message: 「He looks like a fatso, so he's a fatso. Still, though. Quite a bit of your power has been unlocked lately.」

name: Synn
message: 「You... think so...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The day you drown the world in a sea of blood, surround yourself with countless women, and slaughter ten thousand men in a single night isn't far off.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I don't really want to do any of that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Zero ambition.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not selfless. I want to get even stronger.」
The image of Nanaka trembling flashed through my mind.

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh?」

name: Synn
message: 「At this rate, I won't even be able to protect the academy! That's why I have to get stronger.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's the spirit.」

name: Synn
message: 「First, I'll aim to do a handstand using just my pinky finger.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You'll just end up jamming your finger.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right! I'm pretty sure there's a barbell I got from Tame-san's place in the closet!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama, I've been waiting to hear those words.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did the word 'barbell' really carry such a deep meaning?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not that. I've been waiting for the day Synn-sama would seek out strength of his own accord.」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Gulp. Paqy's acting kind of serious.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm always serious. I am the Great Sage Paqy, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's so much to unpack in that line, but I'll let it slide.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Actually, the previous Demon Lord told me to give you something once you'd made up your mind.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh...! What?! A fiery shonen manga development like that?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's a scroll inscribed with the Demon Lord's ultimate technique, the secret art of the Demon Lord Fist.」

name: Synn
message: 「That sounds kinda lame, yet super strong!」

name: Paqy
message: 「However, once this is passed down to you, Synn-sama will walk a blood-soaked demonic path from here on out.」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Gulp.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Since it's passed down to a single heir, Synn-sama's siblings are after it too.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm an only child.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Right. And what I was told to give you isn't a scroll anyway. It's just a letter. Here.」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like it's losing its value before I even open it.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, wait, there's no way Dad would entrust me with something useless!」
Pulling myself together, I hold down the letter from Dad with a ruler and slice open the seal.

name: Synn
message: 「'How to Awaken the Demon Lord's Power'! This is it, this is it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see... 'Guts and willpower'」

name: Synn
message: 「That's it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, there's no way that's it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you forgetting something?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hold up, hold up, just hold on a sec, don't rush it, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「You did forget...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh-heh-heh. Synn-sama is totally hooked on my teasing technique, ain't ya.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gross lines like that aren't gonna fool me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, I ain't tryin' to fool ya. I'm just buildin' suspense so you'll appreciate it more.」

name: Synn
message: 「If 'guts and willpower' alone were enough to bring out the Demon Lord's power, even during all those tight spots up till now--」

name: Paqy
message: 「I remembered! It's 'awareness,' 'awareness'!」
He really did forget. Still, I'd better not say it right now.

name: Synn
message: 「By awareness, you mean... being aware that I'm the Demon Lord?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Spot on.」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought I already was aware, though.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Maybe. Still, somewhere in your heart, Synn-sama, you were denying that you're the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe so...」

name: Paqy
message: 「That mindset got in the way, which is why your awakening was delayed over and over.」

name: Paqy
message: 「But now, Synn-sama, you've accepted it. Means you're ready.」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright! I'll go grab the barbell!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hold on. That kind of physical training isn't what you need.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't keep me in suspense.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Switch your mindset. Just like that, snap!」

name: Synn
message: 「How?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Calm your mind and picture yourself as the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-All right...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm Synn Sakura, the Demon Lord! A second-year at Ryuusei Academy.」

name: Synn
message: 「And the Student Council President. I'm gonna enjoy a sparkling, fun school life to the fullest!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Nothing's happening.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Because other than saying 'I'm the Demon Lord,' you're acting completely normal.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. This is tough.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I get that you love your everyday life, Synn-sama. But extraordinary power is something that breaks out of the everyday.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't overthink it. Just imagine some crazy huge, overwhelming power, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Like a typhoon? Or a volcano? Like I've turned into something like that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「All you can do is give it a shot for now.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-All right. This time for sure... Starting today, I'm becoming the Demon Lord! I'll whip up typhoons and make volcanoes erupt!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!! An earthquake!!」
Suddenly, the floor of the room began to shake.

name: Synn
message: 「And a typhoon on top of that!? Plus the temperature in the room is rising!? This is bad!!」
Hot gusts swirl around me as the center! The clothes I'm wearing look like they're about to burst into flames!

name: Synn
message: 「A fire extinguisher! No, water, water!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't panic, Synn-sama. This is the power of the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, this is!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Way.」

name: Synn
message: 「My skin didn't turn into scales, I didn't grow horns, and my nails didn't turn into diamonds or anything, though.」

name: Paqy
message: 「As if that'd happen.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Amazing!!」
Power surges and overflows from all over my body.

name: Synn
message: 「Woooooaaah! With this power, even Sengen'in-sensei will be a piece of cake--」

name: Paqy
message: 「--nowhere near that, though.」
The moment Paqy's words brought me back to my senses.
All the strength drained right out of my body.

name: Paqy
message: 「Well... since it's your first time, that's about how it goes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... I can't move...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Can't be helped. You're not used to using it yet, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「To master something like this, it takes spirit and guts... Oh, so that's what it means.」

name: Synn
message: 「I've gotta do my best!」
As long as I can master this power, I might even be able to hold my own against Sengen'in-sensei--I mean Soltia, no, even Bylous.

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama, are you planning to tell the Student Council guys that you're the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh... well, that's still a bit...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Look, though. If you use the Demon Lord's power, they'll find out you're the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why? Can't I just use it secretly during a fight?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, the Student Council folks are good-natured, so if you pass it off as hysterical strength, you might fool 'em about the power, but even your hair color changes, y'know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? My hair turns bright blue!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why would it be blue? It's gold, gold.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's against academy rules! Aah... farewell, my sparkling academy life.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's only temporary, so don't worry about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew.」

name: Paqy
message: 「As long as you don't confess, it'll just be your trump card for emergencies.」

name: Synn
message: 「I never intended to show it to anyone from the start.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「Once I gained a decent amount of power, I planned to go on patrol by myself, you see.」

name: Synn
message: 「That way, I can enjoy a sparkling school life with everyone on a normal day.」
I'll use the Demon Lord's power to protect everyone.
If I do that, I won't even have to see Nanaka looking scared anymore.
